title: Domain Care Hosting Credit on Grace-Period Renewal Charges (Domain Registrations, Web Hosting Plans)
content:
## Domain Care — hosting credit earned by a grace-period renewal charge

**Clause.** Under Domain Registrations, for a grace-period renewal charge billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal, the grace line's hosting credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered where a Harborline hosting plan under Web Hosting Plans whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

The plan is read as it stands on the account's records on the day of the price match, not as it stood when the charge was billed.

| Plan with this domain as primary domain, on the day of the price match | Credit |
|---|---|
| Active, billing term 12 months or more | USD 3.00 times the years the charge covered |
| Active, billing term 1 month | USD 1.50 times the years the charge covered |
| Active on any other term, not active, absent, or set up for another primary domain | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- A grace-period renewal charge covering 1 year; the domain is the primary domain of an active plan on a 36-month term: USD 3.00.
- A charge covering 2 years; active plan on a 1-month term: USD 1.50 for each of the 2 years, USD 3.00 in all.
- A charge covering 1 year; the plan for the domain was active when the charge was billed but is no longer active today: nothing.
